projects.name: huly_archive_project
projects.description: Soft-archive a project so it no longer appears in active views while preserving all data (issues, components, milestones, templates) for audit/history. Non-destructive alternative to deletion. Use to retire or temporarily hide a project while keeping artifacts accessible; useful for reducing dashboard noise and maintaining historical traceability. Provide the project identifier (e.g., "PROJ"). Operation is idempotent.

projects.name: huly_create_project
projects.description: Create a new project in the Huly workspace to establish a workstream for organizing issues, components, milestones, and templates. Provide a human-readable name (required) and optional description. Optionally specify a short uppercase identifier (max 5 characters like 'PROJ' or 'WEB'); if omitted, one may be auto-generated from the project name. Essential first step before adding any project artifacts or linking GitHub repositories. Returns the created project with its assigned identifier for subsequent operations.

projects.name: huly_delete_project
projects.description: Permanently delete a project and everything within it (issues, components, milestones, templates). Supports force (override blockers) and dry_run (preview impact without deletion). Highly destructive—run huly_validate_deletion or huly_deletion_impact_preview first to understand impact. Use for test sandboxes or when absolutely certain the project and all its data should be removed.

projects.name: huly_list_projects
projects.description: Read-only listing of all projects in the workspace, including identifier, name, and status. Use to discover available projects, confirm creation, or drive UI pickers/auto-complete. Returns a consistently formatted, idempotent snapshot suitable for indexing or quick lookups.

issues.name: huly_bulk_create_issues
issues.description: Create many issues in one operation. Supply an issues[] array with title and optional fields (description, priority, component, milestone, parent_issue). You can provide defaults{} applied to each item and options{} (batch_size 1–50, default 10; continue_on_error default true; dry_run to validate only). Supports creating sub-issues when parent_issue is provided. Returns a summary with succeeded/failed counts and identifiers for created issues.

issues.name: huly_bulk_delete_issues
issues.description: Delete multiple issues in batches with progress tracking. Provide issue_identifiers[] (e.g., "PROJ-1") and options{}: cascade (delete sub-issues), force (override blockers), dry_run (preview only), continue_on_error, batch_size (1–50). Validates identifier format and deduplicates inputs. Use when cleaning up test data or decommissioning a feature with many related tickets.

issues.name: huly_bulk_update_issues
issues.description: Apply many updates across issues in one request. Provide updates[] with issue_identifier, field (title, description, status, priority, component, milestone), and value. Options support batch_size, continue_on_error, dry_run (validates existence and reports per-item errors without modifying data). Status accepts backlog, todo, in-progress, done, canceled; priority accepts urgent, high, medium, low, none/nopriority (case-insensitive). Returns per-item results and a summary.

issues.name: huly_create_issue
issues.description: Create a single issue in a given project with a title, optional description, priority (low/medium/high/urgent; defaults to medium), component, and milestone. Use for routine ticket creation or when scripting integrations that emit individual units of work. Returns the newly created issue with identifier and metadata.

issues.name: huly_create_subissue
issues.description: Create a sub-issue under an existing parent issue (e.g., "PROJ-123"). Provide the parent_issue_identifier plus title, optional description, priority, component, milestone. Use to break down larger work items into trackable child tasks. Returns the created sub-issue with its identifier and linkage to the parent.

issues.name: huly_delete_issue
issues.description: Delete a single issue by identifier. Options: cascade (also delete sub-issues), force (override blockers), dry_run (preview impact). Validate identifiers with huly_validate_deletion or explore consequences with huly_deletion_impact_preview before executing destructive deletions.

issues.name: huly_get_issue_details
issues.description: Fetch comprehensive details for a specific issue, including full description, comments, and metadata. Read-only, idempotent, and suitable for syncing issue detail views, exporting content, or powering search indexing. Provide an issue identifier like "PROJ-123".

issues.name: huly_list_issues
issues.description: List recent issues for a project with an optional limit (default 50; min 1, max 500). Use for dashboards, paginated lists, or to confirm new issues were created. Returns a stable shape ideal for display or indexing.

issues.name: huly_search_issues
issues.description: Flexible search/filter across issues. Supports project scoping, free-text query (title/description), status, priority (low/medium/high/urgent/NoPriority), assignee, component, milestone, date ranges (created/modified, ISO 8601), and limit. Read-only and idempotent—use for building filtered backlogs, reports, or targeted exports.

issues.name: huly_update_issue
issues.description: Update a single field on an issue. Fields: title, description, status, priority, component, milestone. Status accepts backlog, todo, in-progress, done, canceled (case-insensitive). Priority accepts urgent, high, medium, low, none/nopriority (case-insensitive). Use to drive workflow transitions, reprioritization, or metadata changes from automations or UI actions.

components.name: huly_create_component
components.description: Create a new component (label + optional description) within a project to organize issues by submodule or feature area. Use to establish a taxonomy for routing/ownership and enable component-scoped views and metrics.

components.name: huly_delete_component
components.description: Delete a component from a project. Requires project_identifier and component_label. Supports force and dry_run. Typically preceded by a dry run or validation to confirm no active issues still reference the component. Useful when merging or deprecating components.

components.name: huly_list_components
components.description: Read-only list of all components within a project. Use to populate selectors, validate inputs, or perform audits of component taxonomy before modifications.

milestones.name: huly_create_milestone
milestones.description: Create a milestone with label, optional description, target_date (ISO 8601), and status (planned/in_progress/completed/canceled; defaults to planned). Use to plan releases or time-bound initiatives and then associate issues to the milestone for tracking.

milestones.name: huly_delete_milestone
milestones.description: Delete a milestone from a project. Requires project_identifier and milestone_label. Supports force and dry_run. Best used after validating that no critical issues still depend on the milestone, or when consolidating milestones.

milestones.name: huly_list_milestones
milestones.description: Read-only list of all milestones in a project. Useful for building selection UIs, validating inputs, or auditing milestone coverage and status across a project.

github.name: huly_assign_repository_to_project
github.description: Associate a GitHub repository (owner/repo) with a Huly project to enable integrations and traceability. Idempotent—reassigning the same repo has the same effect. Use to wire up code links, automation, or syncing PRs/issues.

github.name: huly_list_github_repositories
github.description: List all GitHub repositories available via current integrations. Read-only; use for building repo pickers, validation, or verifying connectivity to external source control systems.

comments.name: huly_create_comment
comments.description: Add a comment to an issue (markdown supported). Use for updates, status notes, and collaboration logs—either manually or via automation. Returns the created comment so you can display or index it immediately.

comments.name: huly_list_comments
comments.description: Read-only list of comments on an issue with optional limit (default 50). Use to render conversation history, perform exports, or detect recent discussion activity for alerts and dashboards.

templates.name: huly_add_child_template
templates.description: Attach a child template to an existing parent template to build hierarchical issue structures (e.g., implementation + QA + docs). Provide child attributes (title, description, priority, estimation, optional assignee/component/milestone). Use to evolve templates as processes mature.

templates.name: huly_create_issue_from_template
templates.description: Instantiate issues from a template with optional overrides (title, priority, assignee, component, milestone, estimation) and include_children (default true) to expand any nested child templates. Ideal for repeatable workflows or playbooks where consistent issue structures are desired.

templates.name: huly_create_template
templates.description: Create a reusable issue template for a project with defaults (title, description, priority default medium, estimation default 0, optional assignee/component/milestone) and optional children[] to define multi-step workflows. Use to standardize repeated tasks and enable rapid issue generation.

templates.name: huly_delete_template
templates.description: Permanently remove a template by ID. Destructive—ensure no critical automations depend on it. Common when deprecating outdated processes or replacing with a new consolidated template.

templates.name: huly_get_template_details
templates.description: Fetch detailed information about a template including its child templates. Read-only and idempotent—use to render a template editor/inspector, or to audit template structure before edits or deletions.

templates.name: huly_list_templates
templates.description: List templates in a project, with optional limit (default 50). Use for template pickers, validation, and discovery, or to confirm recent creation operations.

templates.name: huly_remove_child_template
templates.description: Remove a child template from a parent by its 0-based index. Use to refactor or simplify hierarchical templates without having to recreate the parent template.

templates.name: huly_search_templates
templates.description: Search templates by title/description text, optionally scoped to a project, with an optional limit (default 50). Read-only; use to find candidate templates for reuse or update in large catalogs.

templates.name: huly_update_template
templates.description: Update a single field on a template (title, description, priority, estimation, assignee, component, milestone). Value is a string; estimation expects a numeric string. Use to adjust defaults or correct metadata without recreating templates.

validation.name: huly_validate_deletion
validation.description: Preflight check to determine if an entity (issue, project, component, milestone) can be safely deleted. Returns blockers, warnings, and an impact summary; for component/milestone validation, project_identifier is required and dry-run techniques are used internally. Use this before destructive operations or to drive UI confirmation dialogs with clear consequences.

preview.name: huly_deletion_impact_preview
preview.description: Simulate a deletion to preview all affected entities and dependencies without performing the delete. Supports entity_type (issue/project/component/milestone), entity_identifier, optional project_identifier, cascade (for issues), and detailed mode (include per-entity details). Returns a formatted impact report (direct/cascade/total) to inform safe decision-making.
